'''The Buried Dead''' was the name given to the region of the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] that lay to the north of the [[Grim Path]] and west of the wreck of the ''[[Vehement Sword]]''. [[Outpost Zerek]], a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] base, was located at the western end of the area.
